==> ldscript.txt (generated, ldscript) <==
/* ldscript.txt: the build units in ROM order, generated by romlift. */
INCLUDE symbols.ld
SECTIONS {
    . = 0x08000000;
    .text : {
        build/rom_header.o(.text);
        build/crt0.o(.text);
        build/src/main.o(.text);
        build/asm_08000100.o(.text);
    }
    .c_data_main (NOLOAD) : { *src/main.o(.rodata* .data* .bss* COMMON) }
    ASSERT(SIZEOF(.c_data_main) == 0, "src/main.c defines data; see AGENTS.md (only read-only data is placed, in a data range: data_start)")
}
